name: Whisper Tiny
good_at: fine on a very old laptop
limits: least accurate; stumbles on accents, names and noise

name: Whisper Base
good_at: ships with the OS, ready at once
limits: makes more mistakes than the bigger models on hard audio

name: Whisper Small
good_at: still light enough for most machines
limits: about half a gigabyte to download

name: Whisper Large v3 Turbo
good_at: the best dictation here: near large-v3 accuracy, much faster
handles accents, names and noise well
limits: about 0.6 GB to download; wants a few GB of memory
